steps.content: Several days later, Northsnow Manor stands completely abandoned, a place of particularly desolate emptiness.

At the foot of the mountain, the inn still hums with tales concerning the fate of the martial artists who recently gathered. The girl tosses some loose change onto the counter and selects a tabloid to pass the time.

——Martial World Monthly - Special Edition——
"Northsnow Manor Treasure Heist Mystery: 
Secret Codex Lost, Heroes' Fates Revealed"

The pages introduce the martial artists who attended the gathering and depict the gruesome scenes of several deaths. The mysterious manor master's fate and whereabouts remain unknown, and the secret martial arts codex has vanished without a trace. Whispers suggest some unknown Eastian hero made off with it.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Tsk tsk. And they call this journalism? A steaming pile of week-old leftovers, this is. Same old names, same old rumors, not a single interesting bone in this whole sorry carcass of a paper.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: All this fuss over some secret codex is just people scheming and backstabbing for profit. And these so-called heroes are all shine and no substance, like polished chamber pots. Look respectable enough until you get a whiff of what's really inside.
Pen in hand, she dives into the gossip article, making corrections throughout before adding two punchy lines of commentary in bold, dramatic strokes.

Looking around with a furrowed brow, she's still not pleased. She carelessly sketches a few doodles, then decisively crosses out the original headline and pens a new one. Finally satisfied, she sets the pen down.
She drains her tea in one gulp, strides over to the storyteller, and nonchalantly drops the scribbled-on tabloid in front of him. Under the stunned gaze of the onlookers, she makes her grand exit.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: You want news? That rag you're peddling is already moldy. Granny's giving you something... fresh off the press. Still warm.

The storyteller picks up the tabloid in astonishment. Beside the names of the martial artists, she has scrawled various nicknames, and scrawled above them, in a crooked hand, is the title: <color=#fb9259>"Silent Snow, Hidden Plum"</color>.

Delightful Forest Master loved his wine and meat,
till one day he gorged and burst, a gut-spilling feat.
The Gentleman's silver needles gleamed in snow,
yet dread kept him wakeful, fear would not let go.
General Invincible, renowned in war,
met her end by ten thousand arrows and more.
Melodious Pipa smiled, her tune so sweet,
while a blood-soaked blade hid beneath her wood sleeve.
Immortal Healer hung out his shingle with pride,
yet the feared ghosts would come knocking inside.
Golden Brocade, the ever-smiling guest,
wrings tears from flesh and bone, turns sorrow into gold.

Thus it is said: <color=#fb9259>Heroic skin wraps vicious bone;
the stage performs in ghostly tone.
Withered plum reveals old crime;
Death severs guilt in time.</color>

In the blank spaces of the tabloid, nestled among carelessly scribbled doodles, a little beggar holding winter plum blossoms and a gray-clothed hero gripping a sword hilt are drawn. In the bottom right corner of the sketch sits her signature: a tiny spider.
(Scene change)
[Street]
The sky has cleared, the snow no longer bites quite so sharply, and the streets at the foot of the mountain hum with a life they lacked just days ago.

Outside the inn, Ayiguo stretches her stiff limbs. Passersby stare at her bizarre outfit—bare arms and legs in the dead of winter—casting strange looks her way. Far from being bothered, she lifts her chin in confidence, presenting herself for their admiration.

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: Ahhh, the weather's warming up. Time for my little darlings to wake up and smell the sun.

A few small spiders peek out from her sleeves. This batch is noticeably smaller than her previous ones. After all, she has lost quite a number. These new little darlings will need considerable time to grow.

Suddenly, Ayiguo senses something. She focuses intently and closes her eyes as Number Seven's perspective syncs with hers. Before her eyes, a patch of green grassland spreads; the little spider is perched on that person, moving toward the promise of spring.

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: Well, well. Look who's up and about. You've healed nicely, little one. Heading somewhere interesting, are we? Not Eastian... No, no. An outlander, then?

Her connection to the little spider grows spotty, catching only fragments of words like <color=#fb9259>"DisCity"</color> and <color=#fb9259>"Chief."</color> As the distance between them increases, Ayiguo can still sense Number Seven's location, but she can no longer eavesdrop or spy on anything of substance.
With her eyes and ears now quiet, Ayiguo finds herself rather bored. She toys with little spider Number Eight in her hand, but her mind lingers on the encounter with that one.

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: Perhaps... that little one really is my <color=#fb9259>elixir of youth</color>?
Ayiguo traces the discolored markings on her arm. After that night, these signs have definitely faded.
Remembering the jolt of that eerie red light, she clenches her fists around this new lifeline in her endless existence, her eyes bright with a fierce excitement.

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: I wish I could feel it again...

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: Once, twice, what's the difference? Might as well make it a round number while I'm at it. Besides, Eastia's boring me to tears!

Ayiguo slips through the bustling crowds, dissolving into the ordinary streets and alleys of Eastia. Anyone who crosses her receives a casual dose of poison. This journey is simply a change of stage. Time to watch a new show unfold.
The martial world remains a noisy, chaotic mess. Today, a "peerless master" rises; tomorrow, a "champion of justice" falls in bitter defeat. Winning or losing, there is never any certainty.

Thieves plunder thieves, villains tear at each other's throats—none of it concerns this granny. Any good or bad blood she casually creates is just another idle stone placed in the river of her endless years.
What she seeks has always been crystal clear: to live long, to live beautifully, and to live exactly as she pleases.
